Innate: Syndra collects Splinters of Wrath that enhance each of her abilities based on the number of them collected, stacking up to 120 times.
Q 'dealing magic damage to nearby enemies'; E 'deals magic damage to enemies hit'; R 'each dealing magic damage upon hit'. No Q/E/R effect text mentions true damage.
Transcendent Bonus: Collecting 100 Splinters of Wrath enhances Unleashed Power to execute the target if it would damage them to below 15% of their maximum health.

The engine prices the threshold as a display row and does *not* add execute damage to totals (`_add_execute_display`) -- the kill boundary is documented, not double-counted. This is the conservative choice: an execute is an absorbing event, not a damage instance.

Once the mark expires, it detonates to deal true damage equal to the amount stored against the target. (again a true-typed row, if in the build)

independent_computation.step_1_scenario_state: The scenario id carries '120', which matches the only 120-valued Syndra option in the cached wiki text: Splinters of Wrath, 'stacking up to 120 times'. At 120 splinters every Transcendent Bonus is live, including the 60-splinter Force of Will bonus.
independent_computation.step_2_rule: Force of Will's Transcendent Bonus is stated as 'deal 12% (+ 2% per 100 AP) bonus true damage', i.e. bonus = (0.12 + 0.0002*AP) * (W base magic damage), and it is explicitly typed TRUE, separate from the magic recast damage.
independent_computation.step_3_arithmetic_check: Instantiating that rule against W's magic row base [70,100,130,160,190] (+65% AP) reproduces the cached 'Bonus True Damage' leveling row exactly: rank r -> 0.12*base + (0.12*0.65 + 0.0002*base)*AP + 0.0002*0.65*AP^2. Computed flats = [8.4, 12, 15.6, 19.2, 22.8] (cached: identical); computed AP coefficients = [9.2, 9.8, 10.4, 11.0, 11.6] % AP (cached: identical). Summing with the magic row reproduces 'Total Mixed Damage' exactly: flats [78.4, 112, 145.6, 179.2, 212.8] and AP [74.2, 74.8, 75.4, 76.0, 76.6] % AP (cached: identical).
independent_computation.step_4_typing_consequence: The wiki names the combined row 'Total Mixed Damage', which is only coherent if W is authored as two separately typed instances: a magic instance (base + 65% AP) and a true instance (the 12%+2%/100AP bonus). A correct 120-splinter ledger therefore MUST contain at least one true-typed damage event, and that event must be the Force of Will Transcendent bonus.
independent_computation.step_5_elimination: Enumerating every damage-producing row available to Syndra from the cached text: Q magic, W recast magic, W Transcendent bonus TRUE, E magic, R per-sphere magic. The R 100-splinter enhancement is an execute threshold, and math-foundations 1.3 records that executes are priced as display rows, not damage instances, so R contributes no true-typed damage event. No item or rune in the cached data converts Syndra's magic damage to true; the only other true-typed sources (First Strike keystone, Detonation Orb 'The Bomb') are themselves separately-authored bonus rows that are correctly typed true. Hence the single leaf in this fight ledger that can legitimately read 'true' is the Force of Will Transcendent bonus row, and 'magic' on that row was a mistype.
independent_computation.worked_example: Level 18, W rank 5, AP = 0 (bare) -> W magic instance 190 raw magic (mitigated by MR) + 22.8 raw TRUE (unmitigated). With AP = 500 and Transcendence's +15% AP applied first (500 -> 575 effective AP): magic = 190 + 0.65*575 = 563.75; true bonus = (0.12 + 0.0002*575) * 563.75 = 0.235 * 563.75 = 132.5. The bonus is unmitigated by MR; typing it 'magic' would have wrongly run it through 100/(100+MR) (docs/math-foundations.md 2.1), understating it by exactly the mitigation factor.
independent_computation.quantified_error_of_old_value: Typing the bonus 'magic' understates that event by a factor 100/(100+MR); e.g. vs 60 MR the row would be reported at 62.5% of its true value.

residual_uncertainty: The scenario definition itself lives outside the permitted evidence tree (src/, tests/, scripts/ were not read), so the identification of damage_events[4] with the Force of Will Transcendent bonus is by elimination over the cached kit, not by reading the ledger. The elimination is tight: at 120 splinters a true-typed row is mandatory, no Syndra ability row other than the W bonus can be true, and the change flips a type in place (event count unchanged), which is the signature of a mistyped existing bonus row rather than an inserted event.
verdict_rationale: The cached wiki text types the Force of Will Transcendent bonus as TRUE damage, and the arithmetic above reproduces both the 'Bonus True Damage' and 'Total Mixed Damage' rows exactly from that rule. 'true' is the correct value for that leaf; 'magic' was wrong.
